commons.title: Côtes des environs de la rivière Mississippi en 1701.jpg
commons.description: The Gulf of Mexico, Florida and the Mississippi Delta circa 1700. French map that chronicles the exploratory missions of Robert Cavelier de La Salle (1683, 1685) and Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville (1698, 1699).
commons.editorial_reason: Historical regional map, not an image of Tunica culture.

commons.title: BritishWestFlorida1776.jpg
commons.description: The source map depicts the southern British colonies in 1776, including the Carolinas, Georgia, and the Floridas, as well as labeling Indian tribal regions.  This detail depicts British West Florida, roughly including the Gulf Coast between the Mississippi River and the Apalachicola River.
commons.editorial_reason: Historical map showing regional tribal labels; no visible Tunica cultural content.
